name: Reverse Contact
description:
Reverse Contact turns a LinkedIn URL, an email address, or a name and company into a complete professional profile, without leaving the conversation.

Ask for a person and you get their current role, company, work history, education and skills. Ask for a company and you get its size, headquarters, industry and specialties. When you only have an email address, the connector resolves the person behind it directly, with no search step. Broader questions are covered by search across people and companies, with filters on title, industry, location, headcount and more.

Every lookup answers from a cached database first, so results come back instantly and cost less. When freshness matters, the live tools run a fresh LinkedIn scrape and hand the result back once the job completes.

Enrichment is billed in credits from your Reverse Contact workspace, and the connector reports the balance at any time. The same credits, rate limits and data power the REST API, so what you prototype in a conversation runs unchanged in production.

Typical uses: qualifying an inbound lead from nothing but their email, building a target list from a set of filters, checking whether a prospect has changed jobs, enriching a CRM record mid-conversation, and researching a company before a call.

Connecting takes one sign-in. The connector creates a dedicated API key in your workspace and never asks for a password.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Reverse Contact to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Reverse Contact to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.reversecontact.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Reverse Contact MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reverse Contact provides these MCP tools: check_task, check_usage, enrich_company, enrich_company_live, enrich_person, enrich_person_live, search_companies, and search_persons.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Reverse Contact?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Reverse Contact in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Reverse Contact MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reverse Contact requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Reverse Contact is developed by Reverse Contact. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
